key_findings: Groq daily token limit is strictly 200,000 Tokens Per Day (TPD) for qwen/qwen3.8-27b.
The daily limit is a continuous rolling 24-hour sliding window, NOT a fixed midnight UTC reset.

Retry-after and recovery duration scale dynamically with the exact requested token volume: small requests (173 tokens) recover in ~67s as old tokens slide out, while larger requests (4,243 tokens) require ~30 minutes.
When TPD is breached, headers return x-should-retry: false.
TPD (200k tokens) is the true daily bottleneck, running out while 913 out of 1,000 Requests Per Day (RPD) remain unused.
